## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is described as a pale, spiritual-looking maiden. She is also fair with golden features, seen dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is a thoughtful, imaginative, and ambitious student. Despite her pale and spiritual appearance, she is also full of fun, mischief, and pranks.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), where the two formed a close friendship. She later spent time visiting her friends in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) on a memorable spring walk across the countryside to celebrate Anne's adopted birthday. Afterward, Priscilla sent news to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding her aunt, the famous author Mrs. Charlotte E.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> "I’m so sorry, but I’m afraid we won’t get up to Green Gables at all now, for by the time Aunty’s ankle is well she will have to go back to Toronto. She has to be there by a certain date."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> "I wonder what a soul . . . a person’s soul . . . would look like,"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P67](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0067)

> "If a kiss could be seen I think it would look like a violet,"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P11](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0011)

> "How did such graceful feathery things ever come to have such a dreadful name?"

> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P18](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) formed an intimate friendship while attending Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) together. They maintain their close bond through shared excursions, such as a spring birthday walk to explore Hester Gray's old garden with other friends. Priscilla also acts as a bridge to notable acquaintances, passing along news about her famous relative, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), and later bringing her to visit [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md).

- Friend of — intimate academy friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +2 more</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

Priscilla and [Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) were part of a close-knit circle of intimate friends during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy). Together with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), they spent their time at the academy studying, discussing upcoming final examinations, and preparing for commencement.

- Friend of — circle of intimate friends at the Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

### [Jane](../character/jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/jane--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Jane](../character/jane.md) share a casual friendship, joining [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) for a day-long spring walk across the woods and fields. During this birthday outing, they explore unfamiliar paths together, discover Hester Gray's hidden garden, and share lunch and conversation by a brook.

- Comrade of — friends attending a spring picnic day together (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003)</sub>

### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md), a famous author. Priscilla facilitates a meeting between her aunt and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), eventually bringing Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for an unexpected visit and dinner.

- Relative of — niece (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P24](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0024)</sub>
